team_rule: every agent answers; no staffing step
structure: contribution-scored DAG rebuilt each round routes peer responses
stop_rule: three rounds end and the most central response is chosen

mapping.recruit: every agent of the pool, which answers the query in round 0
mapping.assign: the next-round prompt carrying the responses of an agent's predecessors in the contribution-scored DAG
mapping.aggregate: the contribution-weighted centroid that selects one existing response
mapping.submit: the selected response after the last round
